name: PigeonBlood
source:
A local corporation owned by the old house of Kirishima.

Kirishima Kazuki was simple, but was part of an old and respected lineage. 

The memorial services for the sudden death of his older brother were to be held at the Kirishima villa in accordance with old customs.　Kazuki was sinking into depression, having already lost his parents, and now losing his older brother as well. 

The days of performing the ritual to send his brother's soul at a mansion deep in the mountains begin. But those peaceful days are suddenly shattered when one day intruders appear...
translation: 桐岛家拥有的地方企业。桐岛一树虽然平凡，但属于一个古老而受尊敬的家族。按照旧俗，为他哥哥猝死举行的追悼仪式将在桐岛别墅举行。一树已经失去了父母，现在又失去了哥哥，陷入了抑郁。在深山宅邸中为哥哥的灵魂举行仪式的日子开始了。但当有一天入侵者出现时，那些平静的日子突然被打破了……
